 MultiTest-dV with VFG Touchscreen force gauge or ELS and VectorPro Lite or MT
Mecmesin's most versatile entry-level motorised test stand, the MultiTest-dV, is easily configured for product testing or raw materials property evaluation.
Setup 1: MultiTest-dV and gauge
Configure the MultiTest-dV with a digital force gauge, such as the VFG of AFG, and you have instant readings for fast product testing with VectorPro Lite data acquisition and analysis software available for advanced reporting.
Setup 2: MultiTest-dV and load sensor
Alternatively, configure the MultiTest-dV with an Enhanced Load Sensor (ELS) and VectorPro force testing software, and you have an advanced software-controlled tensile and compressive tester for evaluation the physical properties of raw materials.

Choosing your accessories
To achieve accurate test results it's important that your sample is gripped and held correctly. Mecmesin provides a wide range of grips and fixtures for use with our force and torque equipment.
Your test sample should be held securely, so it cannot move during testing and without being deformed.
Creating custom accessories
Mecmesin can design custom grips and fixtures for parts or components with unusual shapes or finishes.
Using 3D printing and CNC machining our expert in-house design and manufacturing team can develop precisely what you need.
